name: Crush
author: hundekraft
description: Crush reduces the signal's bit depth and sample rate, then adds drive. Low bit depth makes a waveform's steps audible; a low sample rate adds aliasing. The artwork is Maiko's, used with permission. It runs on synth, drum and master FX; the master keeps the two channels separate.
credits: Reconstructs Maiko Pruett's #250 algorithm and artwork, used with permission
